from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            n_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DB_WORKER_INFER, prompt_custom.DB_WORKER_DECODE, prompt_custom.DB_WORKER_VERIFY],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.DB_AGG_SUMMARY,
        )
        draft = await debate(problem)
        star_with_coordinator = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DB_COORD_WORKER] * 3,
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.DB_COORD_AGG,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        solution = await star_with_coordinator(problem + "\n\nDebate draft:\n" + (draft.get("response") or "NO_DRAFT"))
        return solution.get("response") or "```text\nA\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
